sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000046-P1, was presented by MERCK & COMPANY (the Supplier) to Northstar Urgent Care 046 on August 17, 2024.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 1 rebate of 3%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a commitment of 170 HPV doses per year.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: awaiting a Customer decision.
